description: This Java class 'ClosedLoopControlQualityMetric' monitors and evaluates the quality of closed-loop control by maintaining a buffer of recent error measurements, computing their standard deviation, and updating sensor values accordingly.

classes.name: ClosedLoopControlQualityMetric
classes.description: A class that calculates and monitors the quality of closed-loop control using recent error measurements.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins scheduled measurement and update of control quality metrics.

methods.name: getStandardDeviation
methods.description: Calculates the standard deviation of the recent errors.

methods.name: rememberCurrentError
methods.description: Stores the latest error measurement into the buffer.
